question: In “Corpse People Busters ④,” Medium described Madelyn as an “snack buddy who keeps me company when Abel-chin is busy.” When Abel isn't busy, do the two of them enjoy tea time together?
answer:
Medium hasn't received any education in how to perform the duties of an empress, so she knows that there's nothing she can really do to help Abel in that regard. When she told Flop that she still wanted to somehow be useful to him, he probably suggested something like, “Then why don't you give His Imperial Majesty a little moment of peace and relaxation by making him some tea and helping him unwind?”

And I think she took that suggestion completely at face value and put it into practice.

Abel can't win against Medium in a verbal argument at all, so they spend time having tea together pretty much every time.

When he's really busy, Abel doesn't have the time to spare, so he enjoys tea with Madelyn, who has begun trying to understand humans.
